officialEvidence.currentOperatorPage: The current SWE e-mobility pages confirm that Stadtwerke Esslingen plans, installs and operates charging infrastructure, including public-space charging, but do not publish a current 2026 universal public charging tariff.
officialEvidence.stationSpecificHistoricalEvidence: The municipality of Deizisau documented a public SWE-operated two-point 22 kW installation opened 2025-03-28 with SWE Lade-App or QR ad-hoc access at 0.55 EUR/kWh plus 0.08 EUR/min after four hours. This is retained only as station-specific 2025 evidence and is not treated as a current 2026 network tariff.

decision: Operator identity and public ad-hoc capability are confirmed, but no authoritative current 2026 station/EVSE tariff matrix or universal tariff was exposed. Do not extrapolate the 2025 Deizisau value to other SWE-operated stations. Defer until after breadth-first traversal; next step is representative SWE QR checkout / current station-level resolution.
nextAfterTraversal: Resolve current SWE-operated EVSE IDs from BNetzA/Mobilithek and query public QR/direct checkout per station where available.
